info.name: NYC Open Data (data.cityofnewyork.us)
info.description:
General-purpose Postman collection for **NYC Open Data** — search the whole catalog, inspect any dataset, and query or download any of its ~2,400 datasets through the Socrata APIs.

1. **Discover** — find a dataset ID (saves the first result to `dataset_id`)
2. **Metadata** — see its columns
3. **Query** — filter, aggregate, download (SoQL)
4. **SODA3** — newer POST endpoint (needs a free app token)
5. **Examples** — PLUTO, DOB filings, landmarks, 311, vital records

No key needed for 1–3 and 5. An app token (`app_token` → `X-App-Token` header) raises rate limits. Results render as tables in the **Visualize** tab.

Docs: https://dev.socrata.com · Discovery API: https://dev.socrata.com/docs/other/discovery
